shellCommands.command: cd /workspace && git status --short && cat package.json && find app src -type f 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | head -50 && ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/

cd /workspace && for f in app/catalog/page.tsx app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx; do echo "== $f"; cat $f; done; ls app/catalog; cat next.config.* 2>/dev/null; grep -ril "prefetch\|instant" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app | head -30
cd /workspace && ls lib tsconfig.json 2>&1; cat tsconfig.json; cat node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/instant-navigation.md
cd /workspace && cat lib/data.ts; git diff package.json
cd /workspace && sed -n '/## Move URL data behind Suspense/,$p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/adopting-partial-prefetching.md | head -250

cd /workspace && f=node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/optimizing-prefetching.md; grep -n "^#\|cacheLife\|stale\|searchParams\|prefetch={true}\|30 sec\|unstable" $f | head -80; cat node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/05-config/01-next-config-js/partialPrefetching.md 2>/dev/null | head -60

cd /workspace && (npx next start -p 3123 >/tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4; for c in sale featured; do curl -s "http://localhost:3123/catalog?category=$c" | grep -o 'Products on sale\|Featured products\|Canvas Tote\|Desk Lamp' | sort -u | tr '\n' ' '; echo; done; pkill -f "next start" ; git diff --stat

cd /workspace && for c in sale featured; do curl -s "http://localhost:3124/catalog?category=$c" | grep -o 'Products on sale\|Featured products\|Canvas Tote\|Desk Lamp' | sort -u | tr '\n' ' '; echo; done
